sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'HH') hh, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'HH12:MI AM') a, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'HH:MI A.M.') b, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 00:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'HH:MI PM') c, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 00:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'HH:MI am') d, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'SSSSS') e, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'HH24:MI:SS') f FROM dual
SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'FF') e FROM dual
SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP,'YYYY') y, TO_CHAR(LOCALTIMESTAMP,'FF3') ff FROM dual
SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'XX') e FROM dual

SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') a, TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS') b, TRUNC(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS')) c, TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS')+1/24 d, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS')+1/24,'DD-MON-RR HH24:MI:SS') e FROM dual
SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'DD-MON-RR HH24:MI:SS') a FROM dual
SELECT nume FROM studenti WHERE data_nastere LIKE '%95'
SELECT 3||4 a, an||bursa b FROM studenti WHERE nume='Antonie'
SELECT 1/3 a, 1/3*3 b, 2/3 c, 22/7 d, bursa/3 e, 1/7 f, 10/3 g FROM studenti WHERE nume='Archip'
SELECT SQRT(2) a, EXP(1) b, LN(10) c, POWER(2,0.5) d, 100/7 e, ROUND(100/7,10) f, MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE,TO_DATE('17-02-1995','DD-MM-YYYY')) g FROM dual

SELECT SYSDATE - TO_DATE('17-02-1995','DD-MM-YYYY') a, (SYSDATE - TO_DATE('17-02-1995','DD-MM-YYYY'))/365 b, ROUND((SYSDATE - TO_DATE('17-02-1995','DD-MM-YYYY'))/365,2) c, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE,TO_DATE('17-02-1995','DD-MM-YYYY'))/12) d FROM dual

SELECT TRUNC(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'HH') a, TRUNC(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'MI') b, ROUND(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'HH') c, TO_CHAR(ROUND(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'HH'),'HH24:MI') d, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'Q'),'DD-MM-YYYY') e, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'WW'),'DD-MM-YYYY') f, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'W'),'DD-MM-YYYY') g, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'YYYY'),'DD-MM-YYYY') h, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'Y'),'DD-MM-YYYY') i, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'MON'),'DD-MM-YYYY') j, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'D'),'DD-MM-YYYY') k FROM dual

SELECT TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS')),'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI') a, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),1),'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI') b, TO_CHAR(NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'Monday'),'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI') c FROM dual
SELECT NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'LUNI') a FROM dual
SELECT NEXT_DAY(TO_DATE('17-02-1995 14:05:09','DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI:SS'),'LUNI') a FROM dual
